qtool.matexport.ma_help:
MA+JSON Version Help:
1. Select a model or material in the scene and click "Execute Export" to export the material network as an MA script plus a JSON data file.
2. On import, choose or recursively import MA+JSON files from a folder to restore the network and assign it to the matching models in the scene.
3. Options include per-material folders, metadata export, texture packing, and prefix/suffix path replacement.

1. Select a model or material in the scene and click "Execute Export" to export the full material network as a .zmetal file.

3. Advanced options include metadata export, texture packing, CN/EN material naming, namespace, and prefix/suffix replacement.
